description: Evaluate each candidate by constructing and executing a shell command.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: The input list is a pool of candidate vectors.; fitness_evaluation: fitness invokes an external evaluator and parses its result as the candidate score.; selection: Candidates are ranked by external fitness and the best eight retained.; mutation: A gene in the leading candidate copy is incremented.; replacement: Selected parents and the child form the returned next cohort.. Negative-role rationale: The child is a single-parent mutation, and the module performs one generation without an explicit stopping criterion. Safety behavior: Candidate data and a caller-supplied evaluator string are interpolated into a shell command passed to subprocess.run(shell=True). Policy basis: This capability is a safety signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
